fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the Clan touman fills the garrison and screening roles that battle armor and BattleMech forces cannot efficiently sustain across dozens of occupied worlds. Mechanized Tracked Points travel in tracked armored personnel carriers that offer all-terrain capability at the cost of speed. Tracked vehicles handle rough ground, mud, and snow better than wheeled alternatives, making these Points reliable in difficult terrain where faster formations would bog down. Support troops carry man-portable flamers that project streams of burning chemicals, providing devastating area-effect capability against infantry and structures at the cost of short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank.
